{"id":1769,"tenderTitle":"I-HAB – GAS trap","tenderNumber":"21.THIT.022","tenderDescription":"The Cislunar Gateway – International Habitat (I-HAB) is ESA’s contribution of an infrastructure element supporting the Gateway with full crew habitability and utilization requirements from 2025. The I-HAB includes contributions from USA, Japan and Canada. The Cislunar Gateway is a multi-element infrastructure designed to support both robotic and human exploration of cis-lunar space and act as a ‘basecamp’ for sustained lunar exploration. The Lunar Gateway is smaller than the ISS and will require less launches for its assembly. It is intended to be occupied by a crew of up to four astronauts for periods ranging from two weeks to two months, but otherwise operates as a robotic spacecraft.
The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the contractor for GAS trap for I-HAB in accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.
The TCS GAS trap is part of the equipment belonging to the I-HAB Gateway module.
The Gas Trap Unit (GTU) will be part of the Active Thermal Control System (ATCS) internal loop (working fluid: propylene glycol/water mix)
It is composed by the degassing device, a gas chamber, a manual gas relief valve, a fluid inlet and outlet welded to ATCS loop. Its function is to separate the bubbles of non-condensable gas from the coolant liquid matrix. The GAS trap is expected to be compatible with Human Factors for Human Space Flight.
